body.x: The content industry has been emerging as a 'Creative Economy' which Korean government announced to merge it with bottom-up creativity. The Smart Content Center is the core organization for this action.

As a part of an effort to support startups' overseas expansion, the Smart Content Center selected some promising companies and participated in The World’s Largest Consumer Electronics Trade Show - CES 2014.

The Smart Content Center was established in May 2012 and now includes around 50 different companies with outstanding technologies and ideas. The Smart Content Center is supporting these companies in all aspects from their plans and development to international business so that they can successfully enter the global market.

The companies which are participating in 2014's CES include, 'Pison contents'; provider of the first Korean global online music distribution platform 'MusicSpray', 'Hisshow'; the provider of the bible animation 'Hisshowbible', 'Publstdio'; provider of an educational interactive appbook, 'Kamon Ltd'; filming system developer with 360 Degree Movie, 'CODELINE'; developer of 'easy&elly'.
Learn more details at the booth of the Smart Content Center(Venetian Ballroom, 2F, Booth# 70231).
